label: Raindrop Bookmark
description: A Raindrop bookmark — a saved link with title, excerpt, optional note, tags, and a parent collection. Maps onto the cross-app `core.bookmark` shape via `compatible_with`.

body.description: Bookmark body — carries Raindrop's `note` so the type satisfies `core.bookmark.body` for cross-app consumers.

excerpt.description: Auto-generated excerpt from the linked page (maps to Raindrop `excerpt`).

note.description: User's personal note (mirrors `body`; kept for upstream fidelity).

domain.description: Host of the link (Raindrop pre-extracts this).

cover.description: Cover image URL (Raindrop auto-extracts one when available).

raindrop_type.description: Raindrop's `type` field — what kind of content the link points at. Field-renamed to avoid shadowing Item's first-class `type` column.

created.description: When the raindrop was saved upstream.

important.description: Raindrop's `important` flag (operator-set; a starred / pinned marker).

collection_id.description: External Raindrop id of the parent collection. Stamped alongside the typed `parent-of` edge so consumers can look up the collection without traversing edges.

media.description: Array of attached media objects `{ link, type }` (Raindrop carries one per attachment).
